# Artifacts (generated by build.py; do not edit)

Every artifact is a Markdown file in `.venture/artifacts/<type>/` with front matter. `status: draft` skips structure checks; `status: final` is validated and is what gates look at.

## market-brief

Headings: `Summary`, `Customer problem`, `Market`, `Competitors`, `Hypotheses`, `Claims register`

Requirements: at least 5 tagged claims ([FACT src=..], [ESTIMATE basis=..], [GUESS]); at least 150 words.

## evidence-plan

Headings: `Hypotheses to test`, `Experiments`, `Pass criteria`, `Kill criteria`

Requirements: at least 100 words.

## verification

Headings: `Method`, `Results`, `Unverifiable claims`

Requirements: at least 80 words.

## redteam

Headings: `Challenges`, `Dissent`, `Residual risk`

Requirements: at least 100 words.

## gtm-plan

Headings: `Positioning`, `Channels`, `Pricing hypothesis`, `Launch plan`, `Metrics`

Requirements: at least 2 tagged claims ([FACT src=..], [ESTIMATE basis=..], [GUESS]); at least 150 words.

## prd

Headings: `Problem`, `Users`, `Scope`, `Non-goals`, `Requirements`, `Acceptance criteria`, `Risks`

Requirements: needs at least 3 acceptance criteria with ids AC-1, AC-2, ...; at least 200 words.

## adr

Headings: `Context`, `Decision`, `Alternatives`, `Consequences`, `Dissent`

Requirements: at least 100 words.

## threat-model

Headings: `Assets`, `Trust boundaries`, `Threats`, `Mitigations`, `Residual risk`

Requirements: needs at least 3 threats with ids T-1, T-2, ...; at least 200 words.

## compliance-map

Headings: `Target market`, `Applicable regimes`, `Obligations`, `Gaps`

Requirements: at least 3 tagged claims ([FACT src=..], [ESTIMATE basis=..], [GUESS]); at least 150 words.

## cost-model

Headings: `Assumptions`, `Hosting`, `Monthly cost`, `Annual cost`, `Sensitivity`

Requirements: at least 3 tagged claims ([FACT src=..], [ESTIMATE basis=..], [GUESS]); state costs with an explicit currency; at least 150 words.

## decision-pack

Headings: `Recommendation`, `Scope of MVP`, `Architecture`, `Cost`, `Risks`, `Open questions`, `Dissent`

Requirements: at least 200 words; at most 1100 words.

## backlog

Headings: `Sprints`, `Tasks`, `Dependencies`

Requirements: tasks need ids TASK-1, TASK-2, ...; at least 80 words.

## test-plan

Headings: `Traceability`, `Test list`

Requirements: map tests to acceptance criteria ids; at least 50 words.

## audit

Headings: `Findings`, `Failure modes considered`, `Verdict`

Requirements: at least 60 words.

## release-report

Headings: `Summary`, `Test results`, `Audit log`, `Known issues`, `Run metrics`

Requirements: at least 150 words.

## Which artifacts each gate needs

- **G1**: market-brief, evidence-plan, verification, redteam (gate G1)
- **G2**: prd, adr, threat-model, compliance-map, cost-model, decision-pack, redteam (gate G2)
- **G3**: release-report, redteam (gate G3)
